idea-plugin.name: Git Commit Template
idea-plugin.description:
## 中文介绍
使用以下模板创建规范的 Git 提交信息：
```text ():
```
这是一个用于创建、格式化和校验 Git 提交信息的 IntelliJ IDEA 插件，帮助你更方便地遵循 Conventional Commits 等提交规范。
我很喜欢原始项目的设计，但原项目已经停止维护，因此我 Fork 了该项目并持续进行功能完善与维护，欢迎使用和反馈。
### 主要功能
- **结构化提交信息**：通过提交类型、作用域、主题、正文和页脚，快速生成规范的提交信息。 - **提交规则校验**：可配置提交类型、长度、必填项等规则，减少不符合团队规范的提交。 - **Gitmoji 支持**：可选择在提交信息中加入 Gitmoji，让提交记录更直观。 - **AI 提交信息生成**：基于当前 Commit 窗口中已勾选的改动，生成符合提交规范的提交信息。 - 支持 **Qwen、ChatGPT/OpenAI、DeepSeek** 及 **自定义 OpenAI-Compatible** 服务。 - 支持请求发送前预览，也支持直接流式生成。 - 仅处理当前已包含的改动，并提供敏感文件过滤、排除规则和数据传输确认，尽量保护代码与隐私。 - **更灵活的多语言配置**： - 可分别设置 **插件窗口显示语言**； - 可分别设置 **AI 生成的提交信息语言**； - 让界面语言和提交信息语言不再必须保持一致，适应国际化团队与不同项目的协作需求。 - **全局与项目级配置**：支持为不同项目设置独立的提交模板和规则。
[当前项目地址](https://github.com/muzilib/commit-template-idea-plugin.git) [原始项目地址](https://github.com/MobileTribe/commit-template-idea-plugin.git) [常见问题（FAQ）](https://plugins.jetbrains.com/plugin/23641-git-commit-template/faq) [提交 Issue](https://github.com/muzilib/commit-template-idea-plugin/issues)
---
## English
Create structured Git commit messages with the following template:
```text ():
```
This IntelliJ IDEA plugin helps you create, format, and validate Git commit messages, making it easier to follow conventions such as Conventional Commits.
I really liked the original project, but it is no longer maintained. Therefore, I forked it and continue to improve and maintain it. Feedback and contributions are welcome.
### Key Features
- **Structured commit messages**: Quickly create consistent messages using a type, scope, subject, body, and footer. - **Commit rule validation**: Configure commit types, length limits, required fields, and other rules to keep commits aligned with your team's conventions. - **Gitmoji support**: Add Gitmoji to commit messages for clearer and more recognizable commit history. - **AI-powered commit suggestions**: Generate convention-compliant commit messages from the changes currently included in the Commit tool window. - Supports **Qwen, ChatGPT/OpenAI, DeepSeek**, and **custom OpenAI-compatible** services. - Supports both request review before sending and direct streaming generation. - Processes only the currently included changes, with sensitive-file filtering, custom exclusion rules, and data-transfer consent to help protect your code and privacy. - **More flexible multilingual configuration**: - Configure the **plugin UI language** independently. - Configure the **language used for AI-generated commit messages** independently. - Use different languages for the interface and commit messages, which is useful for international teams and multi-language projects. - **Global and project-level settings**: Configure different commit templates and rules for individual projects.
[Current project](https://github.com/muzilib/commit-template-idea-plugin.git) [Original project](https://github.com/MobileTribe/commit-template-idea-plugin.git) [FAQ](https://plugins.jetbrains.com/plugin/23641-git-commit-template/faq) [Submit an issue](https://github.com/muzilib/commit-template-idea-plugin/issues)
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Version 1.0.9

1. Added AI-powered commit-message suggestions with request review, direct streaming drafts, and local output validation.

2. Added Qwen, ChatGPT/OpenAI, DeepSeek, and custom OpenAI-Compatible provider configuration, with API keys secured in Password Safe.

3. Added Included Changes Diff filtering, data-transfer consent, sensitive-file protection, and Qwen-specific generation options.

4. Added Chinese and English project documentation with user and developer guidance.

V260102-0123

1. Fixed UI anomalies caused by coroutine context conflicts. Issue #20

V251209-1422

1. A type conversion error occurred in the commit message editing window of Squish commits, causing the main functionality of the plugin to fail to load and display correctly. Issue #19

V250503-1202

1. Fixed the error that the position of multiple monitors exceeds the visible range Issue #17

2. Optimized Git submission template to support optional configuration of Scope Issue #16

V250326-2342

1. Added a settings interface. You can go to "Settings > Tools > Commit Template Idea Plugin" to customize the settings.

2. Added Git submission template customization function to adjust the template content according to needs.

3. Added Gitmoji support to add some fun emojis to your commits. To turn on the Gitmoji option, you can go to the "Git > Log" panel, click the "eye" icon -> Show columns -> Gitmoji to show/hide columns and view emojis in the extended column.

4. Added shortcut key support, now you can use "Alt + Shift + Q" to call up the submission panel

5. Please note that Gitmoji relies on IDEA's experimental API, which may be abandoned in the future depending on the version, causing the plugin to fail.

V250227-1438

1. Breaking update: Refactored the project pop-up window business to provide support for English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, French, Canadian French, German, Italian, Japanese, and Korean. (Note: Language translation is processed using Google Translate, there may be grammatical errors, translation errors, etc. If you encounter any problems, please contact me (email: muzi@muzilib.com))

2. Highlights: Supports recording window position and size, which is more in line with user habits

3. Fix the Chinese garbled error in the multi-line text input box Issue #7

4. Stop supporting gitmoji input Issue #4

V240630-2210

1. Add support for gitmoji

V240604-2259

1. Remove the dependency on the com.intellij.modules.vcs module

V240407-1343

1. Fix the error of failure to generate template if the Scope of this change parameter is empty Issue #3

2. To add support for the Chinese language, you can install the plug-in Chinese ​(Simplified)​ Language Pack / 中文语言包 to gain support

V240302-0007

1. Fixed bug regarding character related methods being removed

V240125-1229

1. Fixed the problem of not being able to be used on IDEA2023.3.2(233), now let’s use it happily!
